tasks.short: Evaluate findings and develop or test equipment and processes.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual equipment or process findings and operating conditions
Prepare comparable equipment or process result tables and plots
Evaluate findings and develop or design justified equipment or process changes
outputs: chosen equipment or process change and test design

steps.what: Conduct actual authorised equipment or process development tests
inputs: chosen equipment or process change and test design

steps.what: Interpret actual tests and write and check development findings and limitations
inputs: chosen equipment or process change and test design

steps.what: Save the checked actual equipment development findings

tasks.design: Configure native exports from {OPS_SYSTEM} and reusable comparison plots in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer checks input conditions, evaluates findings, chooses and tests actual changes and records the final interpretation; no plotting rule chooses equipment or operates it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evaluation can repeat operating-data transfer and comparable plot preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native export mappings and linked charts can reduce repeated transcription and plotting.
tasks.still_hard: Fault causes, design trade-offs and safe test conditions require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes genuine equipment improvement from changed operating conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less data preparation; development and test authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operations exports and configured plots can support equipment evaluation; engineering design and actual testing remain human.

assumptions: Developing, designing and testing are alternative or sequential branches; reweight this provisional mix to actual work. Boundary ends at existing development findings, not production deployment or fabrication; no other-role work is claimed saved.

Operations producer supplies actual equipment identifier, time, condition, value, unit and source version. Engineer verifies comparability and manually completes missing inputs in s1 before s2. Actual test authorisation and setup are provided by the responsible operation; engineer captures real observations in s4 before s5.
Test native exports and charts before code. Existing automatic charts and runtime earn no saving. All interpretation, design decisions, tests and actual findings writing remain retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing findings check, with no extra approval time.
unknowns: Which plots and transfers are already automated?
What development tests does the engineer actually perform?
research_questions: Can native plots reproduce actual comparisons without hiding different operating conditions?

incremental.description: Maintain operating-data mappings and comparison plot definitions.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual equipment development findings and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 data entry + 20 plot preparation = 30; minus 2 upkeep = 28. If half the data and plots are still manual and eligible, 15 minus 2 = 13. Engineering and physical work remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign staff work using actual capacity and requirements.

steps.what: Find and verify actual staff availability, skills and work demand
inputs: actual authorised staff availability and skills

steps.what: Choose work assignments that use actual personnel capacity appropriately
Enter and check actual staff assignments and work-item references
Commit the checked actual staff allocation update
Explain actual assignments and resolve staff concerns and dependencies

tasks.design: Configure native resource views and linked work-item fields in {PROJECT}, using authorised availability from {HCM}. The engineer verifies the inputs, chooses and checks assignments, commits the exact allocation and discusses it with staff; no model ranks worker performance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work assignment can repeat finding availability and entering staff/work references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource views and linked assignment fields can reduce lookup and repeated identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Safe workload, skills, priorities and individual circumstances need managerial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer balances utilisation with actual capability, fatigue and work dependencies.
tasks.altitude: Less capacity lookup; assignment authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project resource views can combine authorised availability and work demand for a human allocator; this does not require worker-performance scoring.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual assignment and communication, not staff execution of assigned work. No employee monitoring or inferred performance data is introduced.

Actual roster owners provide staff identifier, availability window and approved skill categories; work owners provide work identifier, requirement and due date. Engineer checks stale or missing fields in s1 and manually resolves gaps; choices are made in s2 before assignment entry.

Test native resource views before code. Existing availability views earn no saving. Only finding data and repeated identifiers change; assignment judgement and staff discussions remain fully retained. Access and national employee-consultation requirements must match actual use.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Final commit retains one percent and uses the existing allocation check without extra approval time.
unknowns: Are actual availability and skill fields already visible together?
What access and employee consultation apply locally?
research_questions: Can native resource views remove repeated availability searches without introducing performance inference?

incremental.description: Maintain roster/work-field views and permitted access mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final staff allocation update with exact staff, work and project destinations; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 finding + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 12.8; minus 1 upkeep = 11.8. If half that lookup and entry is eligible, 6.4 minus 1 = 5.4. Judgement, communication and commit time stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Simulate reservoir performance for recovery techniques.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual reservoir, well and production history data
Choose reservoir model assumptions, recovery techniques and comparison objectives
Build reservoir model inputs in the reservoir simulation system {OTHER}
Set up and assess simulations for different recovery techniques
Interpret reservoir performance uncertainty and write and check actual simulation findings
Save the checked reservoir model and simulation findings revision

tasks.design: Configure native data imports and reusable model and recovery-case parameters in the reservoir simulation system {OTHER}. The engineer checks history and units, selects model assumptions, assesses runs and interprets uncertainty; solver runtime itself is not counted as human time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reservoir studies can repeat history imports, model fields and recovery-case setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mappings and parameterised recovery cases can reuse actual checked inputs.
tasks.still_hard: History matching, geology, fluid behaviour and extrapolation uncertainty require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer detects a well-fitting model that supports an unjustified recovery forecast.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated simulation entry; reservoir interpretation authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reservoir simulation systems can import histories and reuse model/case parameters; this does not validate reservoir assumptions or establish a labour baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is actual reservoir simulation through checked saved findings, not field recovery implementation or financial approval.

Reservoir and operations owners supply actual grid or property revision, well identifier, date, rate, pressure and units. Engineer verifies mapping and missing data in s1, supplies model assumptions in s2 and captures unsupported inputs manually in s3. Recovery-case choices stay in the engineer's retained s4 time.

Test native imports and case configuration before code. Existing data links, already-configured runs and solver runtime earn no new labour saving. Only actual repeated data and case entry change; all model judgement remains human.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Final save retains one percent and uses the existing findings check without added approval time.
unknowns: Which input mappings and recovery cases are already reusable?
How much case setup is actual manual entry?
research_questions: Can configured cases reproduce actual prior studies with unchanged history, units and model checks?

incremental.description: Maintain reservoir input mappings and recovery-case configurations.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final reservoir simulation findings plus exact s3 model revision and document destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 source entry + 25*0.40 model fields + 15*0.40 case entry = 26; minus 1.5 upkeep = 24.5. If half that repeated entry qualifies, 13 minus 1.5 = 11.5. Solver runtime and model interpretation supply no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and implement environmental controls for oil and gas operations.

steps.what: Find and assess actual environmental requirements, permits and operating evidence
Inspect actual oil and gas operations and environmental control constraints
Design justified environmental controls and actual implementation requirements
outputs: chosen environmental controls and implementation method

steps.what: Document and check the actual control design and implementation instructions
inputs: chosen environmental controls and implementation method
outputs: checked final environmental control design instructions

steps.what: Save the checked environmental control design instructions
inputs: checked final environmental control design instructions

steps.what: Implement actual authorised environmental controls and verify field behaviour
inputs: actual operating authorisation and work conditions

steps.what: Write and check actual control implementation results and unresolved issues
outputs: checked final environmental control implementation record

steps.what: Save the checked actual environmental control implementation record
inputs: checked final environmental control implementation record
outputs: saved actual environmental control implementation record

tasks.design: Configure actual permit and control-reference search in {DOCS}, with linked source and equipment fields in the existing implementation instructions. The engineer inspects, designs and implements actual authorised controls; implementation findings are written only after the field work, without model-selected control changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Control design can repeat finding applicable sources and entering their references into instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and linked instruction fields can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental adequacy, process interaction and safe implementation need site and engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises when a control changes the risk elsewhere in the operation.
tasks.altitude: Less reference handling; environmental control responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document filters and linked instruction fields can support environmental-control records; control design and physical implementation remain engineering work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual control design, the engineer's implementation work and existing records. Operating permission and any independent design approval remain real source dependencies from actual authorised owners, with no avoided other-role labour claimed.

Requirement and permit owners supply actual identifier, applicability and revision; operations provide actual equipment and monitoring context. Engineer assesses sources in s1, captures site observations in s2 and chooses controls in s3. Missing fields stay manual. Actual operating authorisation is checked before field work, and real outcomes are captured only after s6.

Test native search and linked document fields before code. Existing retrieval earns no saving. Only source finding and repeated references change; source reading, design, field implementation and actual outcomes writing stay fully retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Saves retain one percent each; action gates bind the existing final instructions or record check and add no separate approval time.
unknowns: Which permit and equipment fields are already linked?
Who grants actual design and field implementation authorisation?
research_questions: Does reference reuse reduce instruction entry without hiding changed permit or operating conditions?

incremental.description: Maintain permit filters and implementation-instruction field links.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final environmental control design instructions and exact document destination; changes require recheck
s4 checked final environmental control instructions and exact equipment/action within actual operating authorisation; changes require recheck
s7 checked final actual environmental control implementation record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.30 source finding + 14*0.20 repeated instruction fields = 7.3; minus 1 upkeep = 6.3. With half of retrieval and repeated fields eligible, 3.65 minus 1 = 2.65. Design, physical implementation and actual outcome records stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer retains equipment, reservoir, staffing and environmental decisions while repeated data and reference entry can shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Decision rights stay unchanged; validate lower repeated setup effort on actual petroleum engineering work.
